evidence.locator: the display file occupies locations 16384 to 22527
evidence.claim: The display file is the pixel layer at $4000-$57FF, which is why the program clears that range before any attribute is written.
The attribute area is 768 bytes at $5800, one byte per character cell — the basis of the whole unit's cell-based colour model.
The border colour is set by writing port 254, which is what the program's OUT to $FE does.

firmware.guidance: Supply a legally obtained ZX Spectrum 48K ROM at the path above. The ROM is never copied into the report.
firmware.note: Unlike the Amiga proof, this ROM is NOT passed to the emulator. emu198x-spectrum has no --rom flag and resolves the ROM from this fixed path itself, so the proof verifies the ROM the emulator will load rather than handing one over. That is a weaker guarantee: it checks the right bytes are at the right path, not that they were the bytes used. Filed for Emu198x to add an explicit --rom.
